stem.text: A scientist is investigating the properties of a new material. She plots a force-extension graph for the material up to its breaking point.

stem.alt: Force against extension graph: a line from the origin through points P, Q and R, with a change of slope at Q. Axes labelled force and extension.

A.text: The area under the graph from P to R is the strain energy stored in the material.

B.text: The area under the graph from P to R is the work done in stretching the material.

C.text: The material stretches elastically from Q to R.

D.text: The material stretches plastically from P to Q.
